object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Compare versions between which an object was added; an object was inserted before its siblings; an object file with an upper-case .XML extension was added; and a version without the document with one that has it. Expected: exactly the new objects are Added (the upper-case file only on a platform where Mellon loads it as an object); every object of a document that doesn't exist at From is Added; swapping From and To reports the same objects as Deleted.
